proposal.description: Family-run Italian trattoria in downtown Riverton since 2014. We make our pasta by hand every morning and bake Neapolitan-style pizza in a wood-fired oven. Come for a quick lunch, a long dinner with a glass of natural wine, or book our back room for private dinners of up to 20 guests. Takeout and curbside pickup available every day.

sample_review_reply.review_excerpt: Great carbonara but we waited 25 minutes for a table even with a reservation.
sample_review_reply.reply: Thank you for the kind words about the carbonara, and we're sorry about the wait. A reservation should mean a table ready on time; we've changed how we space bookings on busy evenings. We'd love to welcome you back and get it right. Marco, owner
